## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle sub-commentary by [如理](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E7%90%86) on [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8)'s [KR6n0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0032) *Chéng wéishí lùn yǎnmì* (T43n1833). Preserved in the *Xuzangjing* (X50n0816). Together with the longer [KR6n0038](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0038) *Chéng wéishí lùn shū yìyǎn* on Kuījī's *shùjì*, the *yǎnmì shì* belongs to the late-Tang third-generation Cí'ēn commentarial tradition.

**Abstract**

The work glosses the more difficult passages of Zhìzhōu's *yǎnmì*, focusing on the technical-philosophical questions of the *manas*-*ālayavijñāna* relation, the *xiànxíng* / *bīja* doctrine, and the relations among the three natures. As with [KR6n0038](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0038), the dating window adopted (750–850) reflects the conventional placement of [如理](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E7%90%86) in the late-Tang Cí'ēn lineage between the second-generation patriarchs and the Huìchāng-era collapse.
